sloka: ततस्तु दुर्धरो वीरः सरथः सज्यकार्मुकः ।किरन् शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिपेदे महाबलः ।। ५.४६.२२।।।।
transliteration: tatastu durdharo vīraḥ sarathaḥ sajyakārmukaḥ ।kiran śaraśataistīkṣṇairabhipede mahābalaḥ ।। 5.46.22।।।।

translations.english: Then the powerful, hero, Durdhara, mounted on his chariot, fastened his bowstring and hit Hanuman with hundreds of sharp arrows.
